newsitem.title: USA: Klamath to buy 25 Wells Fargo bank branch.
newsitem.headline: Klamath to buy 25 Wells Fargo bank branch.

text.p: Klamath First Bancorp Inc said Friday its Klamath First Federal Savings and Loan Association reached a definitive pact with Wells Fargo and Co to buy 25 Wells Fargo Bank branches in Oregon.
The transaction, which includes deposit accounts of about $273 million and the branch facilities, is expected to be accretive in the short-term, Klamath said.
Wells Fargo previously announced its intent to sell the offices, which are located in small towns and rural areas throughout the state, using a competitive bidding process.
The acquisition would be treated as a purchase for accounting purposes and is expected to close in the third quarter, the company said.
The sale includes owned branch real estate and leases, branch furniture, fixtures and other fixed assets, but not loans except for deposit-secured loans, it said.
Klamath First Bancorp Inc is the holding company for Klamath First Federal Savings and Loan Association.
